svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Vitanaland navigation anatomy (desktop)
svg.text: Stay up to date with your community
Vitanaland navigation — kept 1:1, restyled only for density
Everything you see around this panel already exists today. Spotlight only changes what is inside the page.
Shortcut bar — Vitana Index · Calendar · Alerts · Wallet · Autopilot · Cart
ORB — Vitana voice, bottom-centre of the sidebar
Header bar — StandardHeader, 64 px instead of ~150 px,
keeps emoji title + Autopilot + Vitana Index tiles
Horizontal tabs — SplitBar, now at the end of
the utility bar (where the mode pill sits on phone)
SubNavigation tabs — on screens with sections,
sit on top of the header bar (Discover, Community)
Vertical budget before the first card
Today ≈ 350 px (large header 150 + utility 54 + did-you-know 56 + tabs 50 + gaps)
Spotlight ≈ 130 px (header bar 64 + utility bar with tabs 34 + gaps) → the first card starts above the fold
